Name: Animated Festive Winter Trees - 1.6
Author: TheRealCrbn
Description:
[quote][size=2][b]This is a port/remake of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26612284]paradigmnomad's[/url] mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3929]Animated Festive Winter Tree[/url].[/b][/size][/quote]

[size=2]This mod has always been a favorite of mine, so when I got back into playing stardew, I was sad to see it was abandoned. I rewrote the mod to work with the 1.6 update, and also updated it to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] instead of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url], just in time for the holidays!

This version includes some additional features but shouldn't differ much from the original. There are currently no recolors included and it is just vanilla, however this could be added at a later date if someone sent me the new tree textures.
[/size][size=3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]
[/size]

[/size][u][size=5]Config:[/size][/u][size=3]

[/size][size=2]The mod now includes a few new configuration options too, configurable with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]:[/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[/list]
[list]
[*][u]FestiveTreeEnabled[/u]
﻿[b]true[/b]/false ﻿[b]
enables [/b]or disables trees being animated by this mod[*][u][/u][u]FestiveSaplingEnabled[/u]
﻿[b]true[/b]/false ﻿[b] ﻿
enables [/b]or disables saplings from being animated by this mod[*][u][/u][u]FlickerSpeed  [/u]
﻿﻿changes the speed that the animation occurs: [b]higher[/b] value = [b]slower[/b], lower = faster (I have found that while it can be changed in game this sometimes overloads SMAPI causing a crash)[*][u][/u][u]ToggleMode[/u]
﻿AllWinter/BeforeFeast[/list] ﻿Enables the festive trees either all winter, or just leading up to the Feast of the Winter Star (Winter 20-25)

[size=3]
[/size]

Original description:
[spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HnJnRKU.png[/img]
I've always loved how Animal Crossing's trees change before Dec. 25th and have wanted to bring that to SDV for some time but didn't have the
ability. Now thanks to Space's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url]﻿ I can!
